answer: The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Nobody is waved through free: $68 in fees and a 30-day delay before the stamp dries is the price, and the jade never covers it twice. The desk only stamps a name that carries Havenbound deep-sea fisherman slipway licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence fishermen renew after quay reviews. The tally keeps ferrous. Every raven is counted once.
